svg.title: Растяжка грудных в дверном проёме — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. Draw a single centered held pose of a bilateral standing doorway pectoral stretch. Slight three-quarter front view, full body. Show a recognizable architectural doorframe with two separate upright jambs and connected horizontal top lintel, open empty middle without an actual door. A fully dressed athlete stands between the jambs in a small split stance, one foot forward through the opening, the other behind, both feet down. The upper arms extend left and right close to shoulder height and elbows bend roughly 90 degrees, forearms vertical. Left forearm and open palm lie visibly on the left jamb, right forearm and open palm visibly on the right jamb. Athlete gently shifts the chest through the opening between the supported arms while torso stays tall. Keep the stance quiet and the lower back neutral. Keep both sides of the doorframe fully inside the canvas. Do not depict a wall push-up, forward-folded torso, single side stretch or overhead stretch. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
